correctness.rationale: Using Theta_ij=pi/2-arcsin(T_ij), conditional rotation invariance proves pairwise independence of the three sides; all one-side cubic and two-side mixed cubic terms vanish. Hence centered cubic moment equals -6 E[g(T12)g(T23)g(T31)] for g=arcsin. The odd-power expansion g(t)=sum_j a_j t^(2j+1) has positive coefficients and absolutely convergent sum pi/2 on [-1,1]; each kernel is a tensor-power Gram kernel, giving a positive trace-class spherical operator. Triple expectation is tr(T^3)=sum odd harmonic multiplicity*eigenvalue^3; positive l=1 and l=3 terms yield strict negative sign and strict l1 bound. Independent gamma recurrence/degree-one eigenvalue integration matched ell_d at d=3,4,8,16,32. Exact contractions E[T12 T23 T31]=1/d² and E[T12³ T23 T31]=3/[d²(d+2)] give first two cubic coefficients; higher odd terms bounded by absolute moment O(d^-7/2). Var=3 E[arcsin(T)^2]=3/d+3/d²+O(d^-3), giving cancellation of 1/d correction on standardized skewness; multivariate Gaussian coordinate CLT gives the stated normal limit. Finite quadrature/simulation corroborates but does not prove the series.
residual_risks: Only independent surface-uniform three vertices and intrinsic shorter great-circle sides; not chord perimeter or more vertices.
Asymptotic absolute remainder O(d^-7/2) is weaker than next integer-order terms and does not give an exact all-d CDF.
